prose.counting_rule: Inline mathematics and cross-references count as one token. Citation markup contributes no prose words. Headings and displayed formulas are excluded. Hyphenated terms follow whitespace tokenization. Main figure and table captions are included.

findings.issue: The statement that literal grounding is the extraction bottleneck generalizes beyond the six-paragraph learned pilot. The deterministic adapter also has semantic and coverage limits.
findings.suggestion: The learned pilot exposes a grounding bottleneck.

findings.issue: Tractable witnessing belongs to the independent compiler. The generalized criterion also permits constrained support, whose branch search can be exponential. The sentence could inherit the broader context without its computational scope.
findings.suggestion: Under independent bounds, stability and its witnessing timelines remain tractable without computing every attainable context member.
